name: OPUS EMEA parallel corpus
languages: 22 EU languages incl. sl, en, de, fr, es, cs
notes: PDF-derived EU drug-document parallel corpus, 231 language pairs incl. Slovenian; 26.51M sentence fragments; no license stated on page.

name: MIMIC-IV-Note
notes: 331794 discharge summaries + 2321355 radiology reports; requires CITI training and signed PhysioNet DUA.

name: GGPONC — German oncology guideline corpus
notes: Repo holds processing code only; raw text requires access request via the German Cancer Society guideline program (DKG).

name: SPACCC — Spanish Clinical Case Corpus
notes: 1000 Spanish clinical case reports from open-access SciELO publications, multiple specialties; direct zip download.

name: CodiEsp
notes: Same 1000 clinical cases as SPACCC, annotated with ICD10-CM/PCS codes and text spans for CLEF eHealth 2020.

name: QUAERO French Medical Corpus
notes: 1665 MEDLINE titles + 6 EMEA documents (train+test), annotated for 10 UMLS entity types; open direct download.

name: CLASSLA-web.hr 1.0 (Croatian web corpus)
notes: General Croatian web crawl, not medical-specific; included as multilingual fallback (20GB direct download, CC0).

name: BioASQ datasets (Task A/B/MESINESP/C/Synergy)
notes: Task A 2022 covers 16.2M PubMed articles with MeSH terms; registration required to download.

name: MedMentions
notes: 4392 PubMed titles+abstracts with UMLS entity-linking annotations (full and ST21pv subsets); direct GitHub download.

name: CAS — French corpus of clinical cases
notes: 4900 clinical cases (~1.7M words) from published French literature; paper says it 'will be distributed' via DEFT shared tasks but no direct public download link found on this page.

name: CSEHR — Czech oncology health records
notes: Human-annotated Czech oncology EHR concept-recognition dataset (Masaryk Memorial Cancer Institute); chapter is Springer paywalled, dataset access unclear.
